title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on the Calculation Standards for Infringement of Citizens' Right to Personal Freedom in State Compensation Decisions Made in 2011
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on the Calculation Standard for State Compensation Decisions Made in 2011 Involving the Infringement of Citizens' Right to Personal Freedom

Fa [2011] No. 167

To: High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

The State Compensation Law of the People's Republic of China provides: "Where the personal freedom of a citizen is infringed upon, the daily compensation shall be calculated based on the average daily wage of employees of the previous year in the State."

According to the average annual wage of employees in urban non-private units for 2010 (i.e., the former "national average annual wage of on-the-job employees") issued by the National Bureau of Statistics on May 3, 2011, the average annual wage of employees in urban non-private units for 2010 was RMB 37,147. Applying the formula for calculating the average daily wage provided by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, the standard average daily wage is 37,147 (yuan) ÷ 12 (months) ÷ 21.75 (monthly statutory working days) = 142.33 yuan. Accordingly, when people's courts at all levels make state compensation decisions in 2011, the daily compensation for infringement of a citizen's right to personal freedom shall be 142.33 yuan.

This notice is hereby issued and shall be complied with.

May 4, 2011
